summary: Iteration 6 (frontend-only) verified the new Advanced Filter + Sort + Global Search feature across all 5 grids (Conference Stock /orders, In House Stock /stock, Conference Order Summary /summary, Company Order /company-order, Balance Stock /balance). Backend skipped per E1's instruction (iteration 5 = 28/28). Playwright validated: (a) TEXT operators on Conference Stock ITEM — 'contains VEVO PRINT CS' -> 32 rows shown (31 matches + 1 trailing blank sentinel — matches design), 'equals VEVO PRINT CS' -> 32, 'not_contains VEVO PRINT CS' -> 782 (812-31+1), 'is empty' on item -> 1 (only trailing blank sentinel). (b) NUMERIC operators on QTY — 'qty > 1' UI footer '21 rows shown, sum 98' vs API {count:20, sum:98} (+1 blank row not summed) ✓; 'between 2..5' UI '9 rows shown, sum 24' vs API {count:8, sum:24} (+1 blank not summed) ✓. (c) Global search 'VEVO PRINT CS' combined with column filter (party_name not_empty) narrows to 32 (AND) with CLEAR FILTERS button visible showing 'CLEAR FILTERS'. (d) Value picklist: fill filter-search-item with 'VEVO PRINT CS', SELECT SHOWN picks 1 distinct value, trigger label becomes '1 PICKED', footer -> 32 rows; filter-clear-item resets. (e) Company Order numeric: to_order>10 -> UI total 24 == API sum 24; between 5..20 -> UI 84 == API 84; clear restores 889. (f) Company sort: asc first-10 all 1s (asc), desc first-10 [12,12,8,6,6,...] (desc), clicking desc twice reshuffles to natural order (sort cleared). (g) Summary quantity desc -> [12,12,8,6,6,...] descending ✓. (h) Balance: balance<0 -> UI -889 == API sum -889 across 684 rows; clear restores -850. (i) In House Stock: quantity>=1 leaves 15 lines (all rows already ≥1) — footer recomputes but no change because data already satisfies (expected). (j) Mobile 390x844: filter popover opens and is fully visible; grid horizontally scrolls (scrollWidth 1391 > clientWidth 356). No new bugs. Real 812/10 user data untouched — no writes performed.
action_items: None blocking. Consider (optional): (1) The filter trigger label 'CONTAINS VEVO PRINT CS' can overflow visually on narrow columns — currently truncated with CSS ellipsis, acceptable. (2) When only the trailing blank sentinel is visible (e.g. 'is empty' on item shows 1 row), footer says 'Σ 1 rows shown 0' — technically correct but could confuse users; consider hiding the sentinel from the count. (3) The current auto-appended blank row means a filter 'contains X' where X has N matches always shows N+1 rows in the footer — worth adding a tiny helper text explaining the blank sentinel.
critical_code_review_comments: filters.js matchOp: for numeric 'equals' with empty q returns true (line 50: 'b === null || a === b'). Same for 'not_equals'. That's why 'equals' with empty value behaves like a no-op — correct, but if the value input is left with whitespace it still short-circuits at line 42. OK.

useSheet.filtered keeps blank rows visible under filter — intentional per E1's note. Footer counters (in OrderSheet/StockSheet) include the trailing blank sentinel in 'N rows shown' but exclude it from qty totals. Consider subtracting blank rows from the visible count for cleaner UX.

FilterPopover renders up to 300 distinct values then shows 'Showing X of Y — refine' text. For Conference Stock item column with 243 distinct values this is fine; watch out for very high-cardinality columns like party_name (~unlimited).
useGridFilter.clearAll also resets sort — good. useSheet.clearFilters however does NOT reset any sort (there is no sort on editable sheets — by design), consistent.
distinctValues() sorts locale numeric — good. But it uses set of trimmed strings; if two values differ only by trailing space they merge — likely desired but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of 12 requested flows validated across all 5 grids incl mobile

seed_data_creation: None. All validation cross-checked live GET /api/order-rows, /api/company-order, /api/balance-stock through the browser fetch context. Zero writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter engine at /app/frontend/src/lib/filters.js exposes TEXT_OPS (8) and NUM_OPS (9 incl between). FilterPopover uses prefix + column.key for every testid: '<prefix>filter-<key>' (trigger), '<prefix>filter-panel-<key>', '<prefix>filter-op-<key>' (native select — use select_option), '<prefix>filter-value-<key>', '<prefix>filter-value2-<key>' (only for between), '<prefix>filter-search-<key>', '<prefix>filter-select-all-<key>', '<prefix>filter-value-check-<key>-<value>', '<prefix>filter-clear-<key>', '<prefix>sort-asc-<key>', '<prefix>sort-desc-<key>'. Prefixes: '' (Conference Stock /orders), 'stock-' (/stock), 'summary-' (/summary), 'company-' (/company-order), 'balance-' (/balance). Global search: global-search / stock-global-search / summary-global-search / company-global-search / balance-global-search. Clear-all buttons: clear-filters-btn / stock-clear-filters-btn / summary-clear-filters-btn / company-clear-filters-btn / balance-clear-filters-btn. IMPORTANT: on the two editable sheets (Conference Stock, In House Stock) blank sentinel rows are ALWAYS visible even when filters are active (useSheet.filtered: isBlank(row) || matchRow(...)) — so a text filter that matches N real rows shows N+1 in the footer 'rows shown' counter. Numeric totals (footer qty total etc.) correctly exclude blanks. Balance totals testids: balance-total-stock, balance-total-ordered, balance-total (NOT balance-total-balance).
rca of the issue: No bug. Only two testing gotchas: (1) useSheet.filtered keeps the trailing blank row visible under filter — expected. Any playwright assertion comparing footer 'N rows shown' to API count must add +1. (2) FilterPopover uses Radix portal — the panel opens on document.body, so keyboard.press('Escape') closes it before the next click on a different filter trigger — otherwise the previous panel intercepts.
